## What's new

- **A new pill.** While you speak, the pill is now a small field of glowing dots: your voice lights the middle and drifts out to both ends as it fades. While Murmur writes, two strands of dots twist round each other. On a Mac it now lives at the top of the screen, grown out of the notch (or hanging just below the menu bar on a screen without one), with the green status dot beside the notch when you're not dictating. On Windows it stays at the bottom of the screen.
